name: Wondershare PDFelement
summary: Desktop PDF editor for Windows and Mac with OCR, forms, conversion, redaction and an AI assistant, sold as a yearly, two-year or one-time licence.
best_for: individuals and small offices on Windows or Mac who want a full PDF editor with OCR, forms and conversion, and prefer a one-time licence over an Acrobat subscription
skip_if: you need e-signatures or AI document work at volume, your team needs central licence management at scale, or you only edit a PDF now and then and a free online tool will do
honest_knock: The prices on the store are a launch discount next to higher list prices, and the yearly plan renews automatically. Every paid plan shows only 50 PDF AI uses and 3 eSign requests in the comparison table. A perpetual licence covers PDFelement 13, not later major versions, and the prices we read are for one platform. We have not used PDFelement ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Yearly Plan (Windows, single platform) · per year, V13 launch discount, struck-through price US$129
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-09 in a browser render of pdf.wondershare.com/store/windows-individuals.html, USD, Windows, individuals, single-platform tab) All three prices are shown as a PDFelement 13 launch discount next to a struck-through list price. The Yearly Plan is US$79.99 a year (list US$129) and renews automatically. The 2-Year Plan is US$109.99 (list US$149) and renews manually. The Perpetual Plan is US$129.99 once (list US$159) for perpetual access to PDFelement 13. Each paid plan includes 20 GB of PDFelement Cloud storage, no watermark and tech support; the yearly and 2-year plans include updates for their term. The comparison table gives every paid plan 50 'trial uses' of the PDF AI and 3 eSign requests; the FAQ has a question about extra charges for AI that we could not read in the render. The free trial without an account allows only create, view, protect and organise and adds a watermark; a registered 14-day trial without a card unlocks nearly all features but still watermarks saved files. There is a 30-day money-back guarantee. On the same store, the cross-platform individual licences (desktop plus iOS, Android and web) were US$89.99 a year (list US$305), US$119.99 for two years (list US$510) and US$139.99 once (list US$695), with 100 GB of cloud storage instead of 20 GB; on the perpetual licence, mobile and web access is for a limited time. Mac single-platform, team and education prices were not read.
